claims.claim: The iPhone 18 Pro Max lasts 12 hours and 32 minutes.
claims.quote: with 12 hours and 32. So we're off to a very good start here.

claims.claim: The iPhone 18 Pro Max charges 58% in 20 minutes.
claims.quote: 20 minutes later, that was pretty good. We've got 58% and 63% for the latest iPhones.

claims.claim: The smaller iPhone 18 Pro charges faster than the bigger ones.
claims.quote: Notice also how the smaller Pros charge faster than the bigger ones, because of their not as large batteries.

claims.quote: Apple's kind of caught up, but they're not exactly leading the charge, as it were.

claims.quote: But what I didn't expect to see is that the iPhone 18 Pro Max performed almost identically to the 17 Pro Max.
